Hey Harishan,

Robert John Downey Jr. (born April 4 1965) is an American actor and producer. He first gained attention with teen‑film roles in *Weird Science* (1985) and *Less Than Zero* (1987), earned an Oscar nomination for portraying Charlie Chaplin in *Chaplin* (1992), and later revived his career as Tony Stark / Iron Man in the Marvel Cinematic Universe, starring in ten MCU films from *Iron Man* (2008) through *Avengers: Endgame* (2019).  

His films as a lead have grossed over $14 billion worldwide, making him one of the highest‑grossing actors of all time. He was the highest‑paid actor globally from 2013‑2015 and has won an Academy Award (Best Supporting Actor for *Oppenheimer* 2023), a Daytime Emmy, three Golden Globes, and two BAFTAs.  

Downey is married to producer Susan Downey (since 2005), has three children, and co‑founded the production company Team Downey. He is slated to return to the Marvel franchise as Doctor Doom in *Avengers: Doomsday* (2026).
